name: smwmusic-kirby-mass-attack-jump-out-rally-forth
title: Kirby Mass Attack - Jump Out / Rally Forth
description:
A small introductory screen showing the current stage you're gonna play on. (and a small cute cutscene of the small Kirbys jumping into a switch to open the door to the stage)

There's a define to change the normal stage song, to the boss stage variant. If you want the boss stage variant, open the text file, and change the "Slower_Variant" define value, to anything other than 0.
Keep in mind that by doing so, it'll make the usage of the echo buffer, to mimic the original echoing effect of the slower variant.

Insert sizes
Jump Out insert size: 0x04D5 bytes
Rally Forth insert size: 0x0502 bytes
